_note: English ending dialogue (DAT2/ED*.BIZ), one paragraph per page, read as the game reads it: column 0 bands top to bottom, then column 1, and so on (16 glyphs per band). Draft translation from the baked Japanese. Speaker changes are not marked in the source, so lines run on; stray name headers at the start of a page are dropped. Pages still to do are simply absent.

pages.ED01: Kyosuke... Brother... is that your voice? Kyosuke, why did you train so hard? I lost to you? What kind of training did you do? I haven't changed. I never could beat you, brother, not back then. But I realized something. With a heart you can trust, we can overcome any hardship. A heart you can trust... I feel I left it somewhere long ago. Brother... it's not too late. Yes... I want to be like you all. You can do it. From now on, you're not alone...
pages.ED02: Mom, Mom, hang in there! Batsu... forgive your father... Mom... but because of that guy and his Justice Academy, all kinds of people have been hurt! It's true Father built the school to rule Japan. But it wasn't to torment the weak... Father was only ever ordered around by those in power, and he agonized over the position of us ninja, who ruin people by any means. So he tried to change Japan himself, through education, to make a society with no need for ninja... Then why did Dad drive Mom out? Why didn't he show his face when we were suffering? Building a school means stepping out of the hidden world into the open. So the clan and the powerful came after his life... and to protect us, he... But it's all right now. You grew up fine. From now on, help your father. Got it... I'll change Japan for sure! Two weeks later... Hey, Batsu, what happened to your head? I showed Dad my test score and he punched me. Mom's totally on Dad's side now... Ha ha, at this rate changing Japan is a long way off! Ha ha ha, you said it!
pages.ED03: Batsu... Hinata, class president, what's wrong? You came home victorious, so why so down? Well... I said some awful things to everyone in class, calling them cowards and spineless... One, two, one, two! W-what is all this? Hey, if it isn't Hinata! We can finally fight too. Huh... what do you mean? Back then, sorry we ignored your call. None of us do martial arts like you, so we were scared. But we love this school after all, so we talked it over in class and started training to fight for it ourselves. We may still just be in the way... Ugh! Thank you, class president, everyone, I love you all! Ow ow ow... I'm happy, but please go easy. My whole body aches... cough, cough! S-sorry! Ha ha ha ha ha!
pages.ED04: Bro, I'm sorry. If I hadn't been suspended, I could have protected you... It's my fault your dream got broken! Don't worry about it. The doctor said it'll take time, but my arm will be good as new. Really, bro? Yeah. But I won't make the pros right after graduation, so I'll aim for them from college. Then you'd be my senior in the pros. Quit joking! A shrimp benchwarmer like me could never go pro! Haven't you noticed how much taller you've gotten this year? Your baseball and your height still have room to grow. You'll even be taller than your girlfriend. G-girlfriend? It's nothing like that! Bro, did you hit your head? Come on, if it shows on your face like that, the pitcher will know what you're swinging at. Sheesh. First fix that short temper, or forget the pros...
pages.ED05: We beat the bad guys, and all our club members have left the hospital. Whew, so glad. And... I thought Shoma was a little cool too, hee hee. Senior, it's been a while! Are you all right? Oh, yes, I'm fine, thanks. But I wish I could have seen you in action. You must have been wonderful. No, I don't think so... Hey, if it isn't Natsu! Quit hitting on girls in front of the school! That idiot...! And I'd just started to think better of him... Hey! Shoma, wait! I'm not letting you off today! Heh heh, aren't you getting slow? At this rate nothing is going to happen anytime soon... Well, maybe that's just how those two suit each other.
pages.ED06: Ow ow ow, damn! Roberto, what's wrong? Looks like I hurt my hand... Whoa, this is way more than a little, to the hospital, now! Mom, I'm sorry. Looks like I can't become a J-League goalkeeper... Silly, I don't need to be rich, as long as you're healthy. Mom... Mr. Miura, hello. You weren't home, so I was about to leave. M-Mr. Kimura, I'm so sorry! I got hurt through my own carelessness and can't play goalkeeper, so I can't join the team. What are you talking about? I came today to scout you as a forward. Huh? Your kick power and burst speed are perfect for forward. After graduation, come to us and score lots of goals. Really? Th-thank you! Ow! Hey, careful, I'd be in trouble if you couldn't even do a throw-in. Ha ha... Ahaha... Everyone
pages.ED07: Roy, what's wrong? You're finally going home to America, but you look glum! Oh, it's nothing. Heh heh, I know, Roy. You don't want to part from Batsu and the others, do you? Heh... funny. Not long ago I hated this country so much. If you want, there's still time. Cancel the flight? No, I'll go back to America. I plan to help them in my own way. What?! How? Tiffany, that's still a secret. Twenty years later, he became President of the United States. And through his efforts, Japan-U.S. relations, chilled by trade friction, improved dramatically...
pages.ED08: Roy, you idiot... I don't know if you're going to be a politician or what, but you don't have to go off to Harvard alone! Are we just going to drift apart...? Oh, I know! I've got a great idea! Chairman of Rose International headquarters in Los Angeles, are you feeling unwell? No, it's just... my daughter came home, which is good, but now she says she'll be a bodyguard and she's never home. Well, you always said 'my daughter is such a spoiled child, what a bother,' didn't you? Yes, that's true. But when she's away, I'm lonely. Hee hee, so the president is the spoiled one. Roy, wait for me! From now on, I'll protect you for life!
pages.ED09: WHAT?! You're not going back to America? That's right, Tiffany. Until now I had assumed Japan was a selfish country that didn't keep religious teachings. True, there are bad people. But you must have seen there are plenty of good people too. So I'll become a missionary and stay in this country. And I'll help the people of both nations understand each other better. I see. I'll miss you, but let's both do our best! Fight, Boman! Hey, you're still at it? Of course! I'm teaching English for free, so you can at least do this much. Ugh. Come on, louder! Please support our Love Fundraiser! Once more! Please support our Love Fundraiser...
pages.ED10: Edge, when we heard how you fought, we thought it was super cool! Well, yeah, in my hands anyone goes down in one hit! By the way, those guys from the next school are acting up again, so let's go lean on them. Of course! W-wait, never mind. I've decided I'm done with pointless fights! What, you're not going, Edge? Don't tell me you've gone soft... Edge, don't push it for no reason. You'll lose your girl fans! *Snap!!* If you're going to go that far, fine, I'll go! Yeah! That's our Edge! But no more dirty tricks like before. From now on I'll take them on head-on, like a man! Yeah!
pages.ED11: Big brother, you're alive! Sorry, Akira. Letting a girl like you do something this dangerous... Huh? You're alive? A girl?! I'm sorry I've been lying. The truth is, I'm not the Top Boss's little brother, I'm his little sister... WHAT?! You tricked us! Hey, what are you doing? Ha ha ha, girl or boy, makes no difference to us! Anyway, we've been through life and death together! Calling us strangers now is a bit much! What?! Take care of me, pal! I don't want to be your pal! I want to go back to being a normal high-school girl! Hey, put me down, Gan, you idiot! Please, put me down!
pages.ED12: The Xinhai Revolution started by Sun Yat-sen... Hey, Gan? Oh, Edge. What's with you? You always sleep through class and suddenly you're studying? Well, Akira said 'if you want respect, you have to study like everybody else,' so I thought I'd try a little. Oho, what a noble attitude. Wonder how long it'll last. Um, after that, Japan set up Manchukuo, and... Cho... Chonan-something? Ugh... Who can put up with this nonsense! Smack! What are you doing?! Textbooks aren't free, you know! Being respected is hard... ha ha ha!
pages.ED13: This time, I was taught a great deal by the students. Yes, truly... In fact, I was the heir to the Shimazu-style karate school. Oh, really! It's embarrassing, but after my father died, an ugly succession fight broke out among the relatives. I got fed up and ran away. Before I knew it, I had forgotten 'courage,' the foundation of martial arts. A man like that being brainwashed is only natural. So I'll gather my courage too, like them. Sensei! Yes?! Um, uh, uhhh, I've w-wanted to say this for a long time! Yes? Well, you see, w-with me, you see! Yes ♥ ma-ma-ma-marr... Huh?
pages.ED14: Professor Kyoko, Professor Hideo, it's been a while. So, Kyoko, you finally feel like coming back to the hospital? Without an excellent doctor like you, I've been in a bind. It's fine. As long as you stay by my side, you'll never lose your job again. Professor, I'd like to give you this. Hm? What is this? It's a weekly magazine exposing your collusion with the pharmaceutical company. I reported it under my real name. Y-you! How dare you! I'll make sure you never return to the medical world! Fine by me. I believe my mission is to raise people who won't become rotten like you. I'm sorry... Huh? Why are you apologizing? I snapped at the professor without thinking, and now it might cause trouble for Dr. Shimazu... Leave it to me! Whoever shows up, a ninth-dan karate master like me will chase them off! I'm happy. Thank you.
pages.ED15: Are you all right, old... Dad? What happened to my students? Don't worry, the brainwashing is gone and everyone's back to normal life. I see... I built the academy to change Japan, but as my students grew into fine people, that stopped mattering. Yet students I thought had grown up fine were so easily brainwashed. To think they were a bunch of useless eggheads... I don't think so. I took a quick look at the academy's textbooks the other day and understood none of it. If they can understand that, they're more use to the world than me, right? Ha ha, you're right. How weak of me. All right! Mom, I'm leaving the hospital today. Starting tomorrow, I'll drill their hearts hard! And Batsu, it won't do if you can't even understand the academy's textbooks. You're going back to study! Like hell. Take this!
pages.ED16: Father, the conquest of Japan is now only a matter of time. I have crushed every enemy who opposed me; all that remains is to give the students the order for the coup. But will they truly work for me? Looking into their eyes, I can't shake the feeling that something is different, unlike the eyes of those fearless ones with that 'trusting heart'... Kyosuke, why did you have such eyes? What changed you? No, that isn't it. Once, we both had eyes like that... Ugh, that headache again... Uggg... Father, Father, what should I do! The other me inside me is screaming, writhing in a dark, cold cage as if torn apart! Is this what those fools call 'loneliness'? Ah, Kyosuke, why did you defy me? As long as you were by my side, that was all I needed... Kyosuke...
pages.ED18: It's all right now, isn't it? No school will ever be attacked again... Huh? What's wrong with me? Somehow my body is shaking... It's nothing like after my usual street fights... Why? I just fought desperately to protect my precious school... Ah, I see. Maybe this is what a real fight is... That person must have been fighting for something precious too... What do I fight for in my street fights? Oh well! I'll think about that after I fight!
pages.ED19: It's over. Now no high school across the country will be attacked again. The pain in my right eye scar should ease a little now. What?! Waaah! One week later: it's been a week since Brother stopped coming home. Where in the world did he go? Something must have happened at Gedo High, where he goes. If I wear the helmet Brother gave me and say I'm his younger brother, they'll surely help me. Wait for me, Brother.
pages.ED20: Oops. I only meant to give a little help, but I ended up doing it all. If you do it all, you fail as an educator. Charging ahead when I get absorbed is my bad habit. A quick fix-up and done. Anyway, that teacher was quite a woman, huh. Ha ha ha, brace yourselves, I won't hold back! Here I come! OK! Don't mess up, give it everything! Fighting spirit!
pages.ED21: Clap clap clap! What a magnificent fight! You pass! If you got this far, you're the real deal. Now I can promote you to second year with peace of mind! But! Once you're a second-year, it won't be so easy. Well, you did great today. Starting tomorrow, back to special training!
pages.ED22: What's with that state?! Go and beat Raizo properly! We're doing special training at sea from now... was my plan. But you seem to have done pretty well. For today, go home and rest up.
pages.ED23: Huh? Did I knock him out? ...Which means I didn't get the decisive moment that solved this case on camera! I was supposed to be hiding and getting the scoop! I know! This guy was the mastermind, right? Heave-ho! Okay, pose! With this, Taiyo Newspaper's Scoop of the Year award is mine!
pages.ED24: Wha... Brother Ryu, why are you here? Was I brainwashed or something? I went to avenge my brother, and Ryu ended up saving me. How pathetic! Well, everyone's safe, so who cares! Thanks, Brother Ryu! Ahh
